checks.label: On the straight start, 0.1 mm of stretch reads 200 N/mm², 20 kN and 0.1%; yield, 250 N/mm² and 25 kN, comes at 0.125%
The sketch passes 360 N/mm² at 10%, peaks at 400 N/mm² and 40 kN at 20%, falls to 320 N/mm² by the 30 mm break, and carries nothing once broken
The tensile strength is the maximum on the stress-strain curve: no point on the sketch is higher than its peak
Yield strength is determined at the point where plastic deformation begins: let go anywhere up to yield and no stretch stays; let go anywhere past it and some does
Only when stress is sufficiently low is the deformation it causes in direct proportion to the stress value: stress ÷ strain stays the same all along the straight start, and falls away past yield
Offset for metals is usually specified as 0.2%: the dashed line from 0.2% strain, parallel to the straight start, meets this sketch at its yield strength
Let go at 10 mm and 360 N/mm²: the bar comes back down a line as steep as the straight start, springs back 0.18 mm and keeps 9.82 mm; let go at 0.1 mm, it keeps nothing
The drawing follows the model: at every stretch the dot sits at the stress, the force arrows grow with the force, and the grip moves down as the dot moves right
Half the diameter gives a quarter of the area and four times the stress: the thin bar's drawn stress is four times the thick bar's

The worked numbers: 314 mm², 31.8 and 127 N/mm²; 150 N/mm²; 0.0005 or 0.05%; 0.0006; 70 000 N/mm²; 0.18 mm back, 9.82 mm kept; 2.5; 50 N/mm² and 15.7 kN; 100 N/mm², 0.0005 and 1.5 mm; and each wrong answer's slip
Each puzzle offers three answers and accepts only its right one, every wrong answer has its own hint, nothing is drawn as an answer before Check, and only the right answer is drawn as right
Every demonstration starts after the screen's fade and ends within 4.5 s of its screen opening; an answer is drawn within 3 s of Check
